title: WhatsApp Adds Advanced Privacy for Chats
body: WhatsApp has added an "Advanced Chat Privacy" feature that prevents exporting a chat and blocks automatic media downloads inside the chat.

Simply put: exporting a chat means copying its contents outside the app; the new feature prevents that and protects your privacy, on top of the end-to-end encryption that already protects your messages.
Will you enable Advanced Privacy in your important chats?
